name: craftuary
description: Free crochet, embroidery, cross stitch, knitting and sewing patterns, stitch explanations, craft calculators and a crochet stitch-count check from Craftuary.

interface.longDescription: Craftuary helps makers find and start their next project. Ask for a free crochet, embroidery, cross stitch, knitting or sewing pattern and get matching free patterns from craftuary.com with a photo, size, yarn and a link to the pattern page. Ask how a stitch or technique works (magic ring, single crochet, invisible decrease, French knot, cast on) and get a plain-words explanation with a link to Craftuary's free lesson. Use the calculators to work out stitches, starting chain, rows and yarn for a blanket or scarf, a C2C grid, or increasing evenly across a row. Paste a written crochet pattern (US terms) to count the stitches in every round and see which printed stitch counts to look at before you start.
defaultPrompt: Find me a free crochet bunny pattern.
How many stitches for a 30 x 36 inch baby blanket in worsted?

positive.prompt: Find me a free crochet bunny pattern.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 6 free bunny patterns from craftuary.com with photo, size, yarn and a link to each free pattern page.
Explains the magic ring in plain words, step by step, with a link to Craftuary's free lesson.

positive.prompt: How many stitches for a baby blanket 30 x 36 inches in worsted?
positive.expected_behavior: Works out the starting chain, stitches per row, number of rows and approximate yarn for a 30 x 36 inch worsted blanket.

positive.prompt: Check the stitch counts in this crochet pattern: Rnd 1: 6 sc in magic ring (6). Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12). Rnd 3: sc in next st, inc in next st; repeat around (18).
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many rounds were read, how many printed stitch counts match, any rounds to look at, and a link to the full report on craftuary.com/check. The check is limited to one per day per address; after that it points to craftuary.com.

positive.prompt: Find a free embroidery pattern with flowers for a hoop.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns free embroidery flower patterns from craftuary.com with links to the free pattern pages.
